steps.instruction: 扉が開いたら中に入って

when.condition: The way directly in front of the robot is open: no door panel blocks any part of it.

do.target: center of the elevator car floor

steps.instruction: 中に入ったら180度旋回して
再び扉が開いたら出て

when.condition: The way directly in front of the robot is open: no door panel blocks any part of it.

do.target: hallway floor about 1 m beyond the open doorway
